candidates.tagline: Instagram's new 'r' looks like a 'z' — welcome to Instagzam
candidates.story: Instagram unveiled its first wordmark redesign in a decade on August 13, 2026, but the stylised lowercase 'r' sits so close to the 'g' that the internet immediately renamed the platform 'Instagzam' — a typography design flaw baked into a global brand refresh used by two billion people.
candidates.why_funny: A trillion-dollar company hired designers to update four letters and shipped a logo that mispells the product name at first glance.
candidates.alt: Instagram's 2026 redesigned wordmark displayed in black on a light background, showing the distinctive new lowercase 'r' letterform that closely resembles a 'z'

candidates.tagline: Jaguar's designer admits: the rebrand that broke the internet was a mistake
candidates.story: Jaguar's ex-creative chief Gerry McGovern admitted on August 13–15, 2026 that the company's infamous 2024 'Copy Nothing' rebrand — which replaced all heritage imagery with abstract pink ads and unveiled the Type 00 concept car — caused such extreme backlash that Jaguar scrapped all planned follow-up communications, with McGovern confirming 'the backlash set the schedule.'
candidates.why_funny: They deleted a century of British motoring heritage, replaced it with a CGI pink abstraction, the whole world laughed, and the man who designed it just told a journalist the critics were right.
candidates.alt: The Jaguar Type 00 concept car — the dramatic angular pink-and-silver electric showcar unveiled as the centrepiece of Jaguar's 2024 rebrand, featuring radical styling with no traditional Jaguar design cues
